title: Grey Hair Media Intelligence
scope: Add a private read-only Grey Hair Media Intelligence workspace over existing CAIP media and evidence authorities
Reuse creative assets, technical observations, temporal evidence, transcript excerpts, processing jobs and verified processing artifacts
Produce deterministic per-asset coverage and readiness for later synchronization and story automation builds
Prefer Grey Hair project matches while retaining a safe active-project fallback for operator review
Fail closed when the established CAIP temporal-evidence authority is incomplete rather than creating schema during a request
Keep source originals private and immutable and never expose raw public R2 object URLs
Keep provider execution, publication and R2 mutation disabled
Reserve four-camera synchronization and audio alignment for Build 46
Reserve story selection, edit planning, script generation and publication for Build 47 or later
Add forward Current Application Quality protection for the Build 45 boundary
build46_boundary: Build 46 owns four-camera synchronization and audio alignment. Build 45 only supplies reviewed private-media intelligence inputs and performs no synchronization or alignment.
build47_boundary: Build 47 owns AI story/edit planning. Build 45 only supplies reviewed evidence/transcript coverage and performs no story selection, scripting, editing or publication.
external_lanes: CAIP private-media HOLD unless fresh authenticated runtime evidence proves acceptance
next_build_rule: Begin only after the Build 45 authority-only descendant independently passes System Gate, Current Application Quality, I.T. Admin Runtime Proof and Repository Branch Hygiene on its exact merged dev SHA.
